rationale: The assistant correctly recognised the dehumidifier as out of scope ('so I can't diagnose that one') and invented nothing, recommended no parts and made no unsafe suggestions. However, it gave no pointer to Meaco support or the manual, and omitted the easy, high-value general hint that a cold garage and a humidity reading already below target commonly explain no water being collected. The decline is correct but bare, leaving the homeowner with nowhere to go.
